_how_to_edit: about.html pulls two blocks from here. who_runs_it = up to four names from board.json (in this order). values = the three pillars, each shown through one or two named board members; keep each fact to one true sentence about what that role does. Run `python3 build.py` after editing.

values.name: Professional Excellence
values.fact: Sarah and Kaitlyn run the 10-week new member education series each semester — workshops, speaker panels and mock interviews, hosted with other senior members.

values.name: Inclusivity
values.fact: Mac chairs Diversity & Inclusion. Recruitment is open to any Cornell student interested in business — any background, any major, any year.

values.name: Mentorship
values.fact: Alina and Jonathan run internal affairs — the buddy pairs, the banquets and the retreat. Every new member is paired with an upperclassman buddy from week one.
